purpose: Document Kismayo's local land-registration procedure and bounded anonymous public-source/API checks without treating administrative boundaries as cadastral parcels.
assessment: The official Kismayo municipality site confirms the local municipal context. The official Nagaad RAP states that Kismayo Municipality processes Jubaland title deeds for affected residents and describes land-administration responsibilities and escalation through the Land Committee and Mayor's office. This supports registryFound=true as a local procedure, but no anonymous cadastral parcel geometry service was verified. A public ArcGIS layer responded with administrative district-boundary metadata and is explicitly excluded as parcel evidence.
registryAssessment: Local registry/procedure evidenced by the official RAP's municipal Jubaland title-deed processing statement. No open registry database, parcel identifier schema, or cadastral geometry endpoint was verified.
